Krownlandia Rhythm Sampler

Compare two four-beat patterns. Count each beat at the same pace, including rests. Try tapping the beats, saying “low” or “high,” or using the optional audio controls. Nothing plays until you choose Play.

Inspired by Krown Concert Hall, credited to @dracrow in the historical inventory (page 11). These exercises and synthesized notes were made for the prototype. They are separate from the park’s fountain sounds and do not represent a built concert venue.

Opening pattern

  1. Low note
  2. High note
  3. Rest
  4. High note

Listen or tap again. The rest makes a gap between the two high notes.

Reply pattern

  1. High note
  2. Rest
  3. Low note
  4. Low note

The gap comes earlier, and the last two beats repeat the low note.

Try your own: Keep four beats and put one rest somewhere else. Say or write down your pattern so someone can follow it without hearing it.

Try the Airtime Puzzle to arrange a pretend program using written clues.
